description.text: High-Class Deck Inteleon VMAX, a 60-card deck released on 28 May 2021 with Gengar VMAX's, built from Rapid Strike cards around two Inteleon V and two Inteleon VMAX, whose Ability places damage counters on the opponent's Benched Pokémon even from the Bench. Octillery searches the deck for a Rapid Strike card, and the deck brought the new Supporter Adventurer's Discovery, which finds up to three Pokémon V. Every one of its 60 cards is holo, and a special-art version of its Pokémon VMAX could rarely be found in place of the regular one. It came with a coin, damage counters and markers and a player's guide, and the two High-Class Decks were also sold together in a Double BOX with Tyranitar V and Empoleon V promos.
